component.name: Voz
component.summary: Record and transcribe your mic and meetings, locally

description.p: Voz is a local-first voice recorder and transcriber that lives in your system tray. It captures your microphone and the meeting audio you hear at the same time — without joining the meeting — and turns each recording into two linked Obsidian-friendly notes: a verbatim transcript and a clean summary.

Transcription runs on your machine with whisper.cpp (CPU, or GPU via Vulkan or CUDA). The only network use is an optional AI cleanup step you choose and can turn off. Your audio and notes never leave your computer.

screenshot.caption: The Voz panel, recording with a live transcript preview

description.p: First release: local dual-source capture, whisper.cpp transcription, Raw + Refined Obsidian notes, tray GUI, live transcript preview.
